Both witness graphs have quotient Q=((0,1,1),(2,0,2),(2,2,1)); one has repeated ear neighborhoods and the other four distinct, and the pair is isomorphic to published graph6 G}pOgg and G}TdC_. Outerplanarity difference follows from K2,3 subgraph versus outer Hamiltonian embedding.
